_notes.bind: Address the HTTP server listens on. Keep 127.0.0.1 when using a reverse proxy.
_notes.port: TCP port for the HTTP server.
_notes.root: Directory exposed by the file browser.
_notes.auth.password: HTTP Basic Auth password. Prefer setting DL_AUTH in the environment.
_notes.tts.rate: Default speech rate multiplier, for example 1.0.
